description: Shortlist testing labs that CPSC currently accepts for every test a product needs, in one country (default Vietnam and China). Pass ruleIds from find_cert_rules (testedRuleIds), and country if the user names one. For a toy, f963Sections narrows the ASTM F963 sections; metalParts adds the lead in metal test. Returns each lab's name, city, accreditation body and its CPSC detail page. Reads the live CPSC lab list. It does not book a lab or quote prices.

country.description: Country where the goods are made or tested, such as Vietnam or China (default: both)

f963Sections.description: Only these ASTM F963 sections for a toy, such as ["4.3.5.1(2)", "4.3.5.2", "4.6"] (default: all common toy sections)

metalParts.description: True when the product has metal parts, so the lab must also test lead in metal

ruleIds.description: Rule ids from find_cert_rules (testedRuleIds), such as ["lead-content", "lead-paint", "small-parts"]

name: find_accepted_labs
title: Find CPSC-accepted labs
